# apollo_graph (Data Source)

Reads GraphOS graph metadata for brownfield discovery and module composition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apollo_graph" "inventory" {
  graph_id = "inventory"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph_id` (String) Graph identifier to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable graph identifier returned by GraphOS.
- `name` (String) Graph name returned by GraphOS.
- `title` (String) Optional graph title returned by GraphOS.
- `variant_names` (List of String) Variant names currently visible on the graph.
